summary: This small file holds the basic description of the Lessons Learnt tool, such as its name, subtitle, status, icon and web path, without the page itself.
purpose: Lets the app list the tool and link to it without loading the full page code.
why: Likely reason: the app can show the tool list quickly, because the heavy page code does not need to load for that. Reason not stated in the code.
how: It imports the icon and the tool description type, then exports one object with the tool's name, subtitle, status, icon and path. The type check makes sure the object matches the tool description but leaves out the component.
inputs: None at run time. The values are written directly in the file.
outputs: A tool description object used by the app's tool list.
risks: It repeats the name, subtitle, status and path from the main page file. If one copy changes and the other does not, the list and the page will disagree.
debug: If the tool is missing from the list or links to the wrong place, compare this file's path and status with the main page file.
